accepted_answers.name: tenacity
accepted_answers.why: Standard retry decorator: stop/wait conditions with exponential backoff and jitter, replacing the recursive _request retry_counter plus hand-tuned sleeps.

accepted_answers.name: backoff
accepted_answers.why: Accepted alternative with decorator-based backoff if the simpler on-exception API is preferred.

notes: Baseline commit 9ec69cb66eec929d08ca90a82081b8ee4eef8b54. Baseline suite: 104 passed, 1 failed. The single failure (tests/test_timezone.py::TimezoneTest::test_los_angeles_with_no_timestamp) is a Windows-only platform artifact: MockDatetime yields a pre-1970-UTC naive datetime whose .timestamp() raises OSError on Windows when the system zone is ahead of UTC (host zone GMT Standard Time / BST); unrelated to the retry component and green on Linux CI. Target confirmed: googlemaps/client.py _request recurses with retry_counter and time.sleep calls. Requires pytest-cov (setup.cfg addopts) plus responses lib.
problem: Retrying flaky HTTP calls with hand-rolled recursive retry counters and sleeps instead of a retry library.
